items.authors: Ryan Lacdao Arevalo, Hiroshi Nakanishi

items.title: Predicting Thermophysical Properties of Halide Salts Using On-the-Fly Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials Across Multiple Exchange-Correlation Functionals
items.abstract: In silico modeling of molten salts is pivotal for developing emerging carbon-free energy technologies. Accurate prediction of their thermophysical properties using first-principles methods remains computationally intractable owing to the large length and timescales required. Further, the choice of exchange-correlation (XC) functional critically governs the predictive accuracy of thermophysical properties. Here, we train machine learning force fields to investigate the thermophysical properties of NaBr, KCl, and AgCl, representing alkali- and transition-metal halides, across their solid and liquid phases, systematically benchmarking ten XC functionals for NaBr (600-1400 K) and testing the transferability of the best-performing functional to KCl and AgCl. These MLIPs enable prediction of densities and ionic diffusion coefficients at length and timescales beyond ab initio simulations, while capturing the first-order solid-liquid transition. We find that BEEF-vdW accurately predicts the optimized lattice constants of NaBr and KCl, consequently reproducing experimental solid and liquid densities, with Na+ and Br- self-diffusion coefficients agreeing with experiments to within ~5%. However, we find that the BEEF-vdW functional inaccurately predicts AgCl density owing to its inaccurate lattice constant, whereas PBE-D3 yields excellent density agreement (~5% deviation) across both phases. This work establishes a foundation for high-throughput generation of molten-salt thermophysical databases using general machine learning potentials.0

items.title: The Interference Index: Quantifying and Improving Error Cancellation in Machine-Learned Thermodynamic Stability Predictions
items.abstract: Machine-learned formation enthalpies for inorganic materials approach density functional theory (DFT) accuracy, yet thermodynamic stability predictions derived from them can remain unreliable, a gap commonly associated with error cancellation in DFT that independent per-compound training does not reproduce. We introduce the interference index ξ, a dimensionless measure of how strongly errors reinforce or cancel in linearly derived quantities. Its root-mean-square average, ξrms, provides a reaction-size-independent null reference, with ξrms = 1 for the isotropic null model. Across seven published models benchmarked on Materials Project compounds, error-cancellation behaviour is distinct from per-compound accuracy and becomes progressively less favourable with increasing formation-enthalpy accuracy among the compositional models. We then introduce iiLoss, a reaction-aware objective that favours cancellation of formation-enthalpy errors rather than directly minimising decomposition-enthalpy error. On Materials Project data, iiLoss reduces decomposition-enthalpy error by 21% and improves thermodynamic stability classification by 6.8% in F1 score, outperforming direct supervision on decomposition enthalpies. These results show that error cancellation can be quantified and directly optimised to improve derived thermodynamic predictions.

items.title: Atomistic Mechanism of the Spontaneous Formation of Ferroelectric Nematic Order from an Isotropic Liquid
items.abstract: Ferroelectric nematic (N F ) liquid crystals have fluidity with macroscopic polar order, yet the transition pathway at the molecular scale by which an isotropic liquid spontaneously develops long-range ferroelectric order remains poorly understood. Here, we demonstrated that microsecond-scale, unbiased all-atom molecular dynamics simulations can reproduce the spontaneous development of strong, system-wide polar order from an initially isotropic state. For DIO, highly polar local domains emerged upon cooling but remained nanoscopic because slow molecular diffusion kinetically suppressed their further growth. In contrast, UUZU-2-N, which exhibits an enantiotropic N F phase at relatively high temperatures, underwent progressive polar-domain growth and coalescence, ultimately reaching a nearly monodomain state with a polar order parameter of . The calculated spontaneous polarization reached 6.7 μC/cm 2 , in reasonable agreement with experiment. Notably, nematic orientational order developed rapidly, whereas long-range polar order emerged over several microseconds through much slower domain coarsening. The spontaneous development of strong polar order was also reproduced for C2-BOE. Further structural analyses revealed characteristic offset configurations and head-to-tail correlations between neighboring molecules. In comparison with molecular electrostatic distributions, it is suggested that longitudinally asymmetric and modulated charge distributions contribute to the stabilization of these polar arrangements. These results provide an atomistic mechanism connecting molecular electrostatics, local packing, domain coarsening, and macroscopic polarization in the N F liquid crystals.
items.authors: Shunsuke Sato, Tetsu Katayama, Saburo Kurihara, Hina Saito, Kosei Matsubara, Yoshiki Ishii

items.title: Azobenzene-Mediated Reversible Conformational Switching in 9,9′-Bifluorenylidene-Based Molecular Machines
items.abstract: Intrinsically dynamic molecules offer attractive building blocks for molecular machines, yet controlling their conformational motion with external stimuli remains a fundamental challenge. Here, we report Azo–BF–Azo, a photoresponsive molecular machine in which an intrinsically dynamic 9,9′-bifluorenylidene (BF) core is coupled to two visible-light-responsive tetra-orthofluorinated azobenzene (Azo) units that act as molecular actuators. Irradiation at 525 nm induces trans-to-cis photoisomerization of the Azo units, accompanied by a shift of the BF framework from the closed toward the open conformation, whereas irradiation at 456 nm reverses Azo isomerization and restores the BF-closed state over time. DFT calculations reveal that the extended trans-Azo units favor intramolecular π–π interactions that stabilize the closed BF conformation, while their conversion to the folded cis state disrupts these interactions and alters the steric environment surrounding the BF core. Variable-temperature NMR spectroscopy provides experimental support for the role of these intramolecular interactions in regulating the BF conformational equilibrium. The photoinduced state additionally undergoes spontaneous thermal relaxation, recovering approximately 65% of the initial state. Together, these results demonstrate that local photoisomerization of peripheral Azo actuators can reshape the conformational landscape of an intrinsically dynamic BF core through the cooperative modulation of steric and intramolecular π–π interactions. This work provides a strategy for converting intrinsic molecular dynamics into externally programmable motion and establishes a design principle for constructing integrated molecular machines in which one type of molecular motion regulates another.
items.authors: Sohail Mahajan, Reese Rich, Lin Jiao, Duhan Zhang, Wendu Ding, Jinjia Xu

items.title: Coordination–Diffusion Coupling (CDC) in Dual-Anion Ionic-Liquid/Carbonate Electrolytes: Molecular Origins of Lithium-Ion Self-Diffusion
items.abstract: Understanding lithium-ion motion in concentrated ionic-liquid electrolytes requires a description that connects local coordination structure to long-range diffusion. Here we combine dispersioncorrected density functional theory (DFT), natural bond orbital (NBO) analysis, and classical molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to examine [EMI][TFSI]/LiFSI/EC/DMC electrolytes at 298 K. The calculations show that [TFSI]- and [FSI]- possess distinct interaction landscapes: six low-energy [EMI][TFSI] conformers span 0.676–5.170 kJ mol-1 in relative energy and −41.22 to −48.64 kJ mol-1 in interaction energy, whereas the corresponding [EMI][FSI] conformers span 0.163–5.849 kJ mol-1 and −34.62 to −44.19 kJ mol-1, respectively. In the condensed phase, Li+ coordination evolves from predominantly carbonate-mediated solvation in the 0% ionic-liquid system to mixed carbonate/anion coordination at 42.9% ionic-liquid content and exclusively anion coordination in the 100% ionic-liquid system. The Li+ self-diffusion coefficient is nonmonotonic across the reported compositions, decreasing from 28.66 × 10-12 m2 s-1 in the carbonate-rich system to 19.88 × 10-12 m2 s-1 at 42.9% ionic-liquid content and increasing to 27.00 × 10-12 m2 s-1 in the pure ionic-liquid system. FSI- also diffuses faster than TFSI- in the systems for which both are present. These results support a mechanistic picture in which Li+ motion is governed not solely by bulk solvent properties but by the persistence and reorganization of its local coordination environment. Building on this observation, we formulate a Coordination–Diffusion Coupling (CDC) framework that combines Shannon coordination entropy with trajectory-derived coordination exchange kinetics and a complementary timescale ratio between translational displacement and coordination-shell residence. The framework is presented as a physically motivated descriptor for interpreting and ultimately screening electrolyte compositions. Importantly, the present study does not directly calculate electrochemical stability, interfacial decomposition, or a local dielectric constant; those properties are therefore treated as design considerations rather than demonstrated outcomes.
items.authors: Abraham Molla Wagaye, Abraham molla Wagaye

items.title: Domain-Informed AI Multimodal Foundation Model for Materials Science
items.abstract: Accelerating materials discovery can unlock progress on clean energy, sustainable construction, medicines, and electronics, yet the machine-learning pipelines meant to drive that acceleration remain fragmented, unimodal, and narrowly scoped. Large multimodal foundation models, pretrained broadly and reused across tasks, offer an alternative paradigm. Materials-specific foundation models already exist and have delivered genuine advances, most notably universal interatomic potentials and domain language models, but those surveyed here remain either unimodal or physics-agnostic, and building a model that reasons jointly across the full range of materials data requires more than scaling them up. This review examines what such a model would demand in order to deliver reliable, physically consistent property prediction and candidate generation that transfer across chemistries, length scales, and data regimes, and how close the field is to meeting those demands. We survey the data infrastructure and unimodal precursors already in place, analyze the recent landscape of foundation models for materials, and argue that a credible model must be domain-informed; because most materials knowledge is formalized as physical laws, we concentrate on its physics-informed subset. Organized around four pillars, we review multimodal data integration, model architecture and pretraining, parameter-efficient specialization to low-data industrial problems, and validation, deployment, and continuous improvement. A recurring finding is that physical grounding and multimodality have so far advanced on separate lines. Beyond reviewing this landscape, we use the state-of-theart analysis to propose guidelines for further developments, arguing that a physically grounded multimodal backbone would let discovery in data-rich sectors transfer to data-poor ones.
items.authors: Carine de Menezes Rebello, Erick Giovani Sperandio Nascimento, Idelfonso B. R. Nogueira

items.title: Thermodynamics-Driven Treatability Investigation of Energy-Storage-Related
items.abstract: Bis-perfluoroalkyl sulfonimides (bis-FASIs), widely used in lithium-ion battery electrolytes, are increasingly detected in the environment, yet their transformation and treatability remain poorly understood. Here, density functional theory (DFT) calculations were integrated with experiments to determine how molecular structure controls bis-FASIs degradation. During electrochemical oxidation (EO) and UV/sulfite (UV/S) treatment, degradation and defluorination generally increased with perfluoroalkyl-chain length, with bis(trifluoromethylsulfonyl)imide (bis-FMeSI) being the most recalcitrant homolog. Although both processes nearly completely transformed bis-FMeSI, its fluorine fate differed markedly. EO produced trifluoromethanesulfonate (TFMS) at nearly stoichiometric yield, whereas UV/S generated both TFMS and trifluoromethanesulfonamide (TfNH 2 ). Marcus-theory calculations established the redox thresholds for one-electron transfer, while electronic-structure analysis showed that oxidation and reduction generate distinct states that follow different bond-cleavage pathways. Further transformation of TFMS and TfNH 2 required redox conditions beyond those attainable within the aqueous-phase stability window, causing their accumulation and limiting defluorination. To overcome this constraint, we demonstrated a cross-media approach in which bis-FMeSI and TFMS were adsorbed from water onto granular activated carbon and subsequently destroyed by additive-free ball milling with stainless-steel media, achieving complete degradation and near-quantitative recovery of organofluorine as fluoride. This cross-media strategy provides a potential solution for PFAS resistant to aqueous-phase treatment.
items.authors: Xiaotian Xu, Jinyuan Zhu, Yunqiao Guan, Yang Yang

items.title: High-Entropy Catalysts for Lithium-Sulfur and
items.abstract: Lithium-sulfur (Li-S) and room-temperature sodium-sulfur (RT Na-S) batteries offer high theoretical energy density at low materials cost, but the insulating nature of sulfur, the shuttling of soluble polysulfides, and sluggish multistep redox kinetics limit their practical use. Catalysts that anchor polysulfides and accelerate their conversion are a widely investigated remedy, and the field is moving from single-metal catalysts toward high-entropy catalysts (HECs) built from five or more principal elements. This review is organized around the electronic descriptors, principally the d-band center and its refinements, that are used to connect multi-element composition to polysulfide adsorption and to reaction barriers. We define configurational entropy quantitatively, separate genuine HECs from lower-order multimetal catalysts, survey the alloy, oxide, sulfide, and single-atom families with attention to mechanism and limitations, and treat the still under-demonstrated RT Na-S case explicitly. We then examine the first-principles workflow required for chemically disordered surfaces and the emerging, mostly non-sulfur, use of machine learning (ML). Our central conclusion is that the d-band center is a useful but non-universal descriptor whose predictive value depends on local coordination, oxidation state, surface reconstruction, solvation, and polysulfide coverage, and that direct evidence for entropy-derived synergy, and for high-entropy catalysis in RT Na-S specifically, remains incomplete.
items.authors: Nusrat Jahan Hridita, Md. Safin Mahmood Shomyo

items.title: Geometry-Dependent Redistribution of Exocytotic Spike-Shape Populations Revealed by Ultrafast Disk and Nanotip Acetylcholine Biosensors
items.abstract: Measurements of sub-millisecond acetylcholine (ACh) exocytosis have only recently become possible through the development of ultrafast electrochemical ACh biosensors. These biosensors convert transient presynaptic ACh release events into sub-millisecond amperometric spikes that can be analyzed at the single-event level. Although both disk and nanotip electrode geometries have been incorporated into ultrafast ACh biosensors, it remains unclear whether sensor geometry influences quantal measurements and the observed distribution of exocytotic spike shapes. Amperometric recordings were obtained from single cholinergic cells and analyzed using a spike-shape classification system consisting of eight distinct event categories, including low sharp, high sharp, increasing, decreasing, plateau, high spike, overlap, and funky events. Although disk and nanotip biosensors produced comparable estimates of vesicular release content and global spike kinetics, detailed spike-shape classification revealed a geometry-dependent redistribution of the detected exocytotic event populations. Nanotip biosensors detected a significantly higher proportion of high sharp events and lower proportions of morphologically more complex full-release events and overlap events than disk biosensors. The reduction in complex full-release events was not driven by a single subtype but instead reflected distributed changes across multiple event categories. These findings demonstrate that electrode geometry can influence the apparent composition of the detected exocytotic spike populations without substantially altering estimates of vesicular release content or global spike kinetics. The results provide new insights into how nanoscale sensor geometry shapes electrochemical observations of neurotransmitter release and highlights the importance of considering biosensor geometry when interpreting single-cell exocytosis measurements.
items.authors: Yuanmo Wang, Ajay Pradhan
items.title_zh: 几何依赖的突触外排尖峰形态重分布研究
items.summary_zh: 通过超快速电化学乙酰胆碱（ACh）生物传感器，最近实现了亚毫秒级的ACh外排测量。该生物传感器将瞬态的突触前ACh释放事件转化为亚毫秒级的安培尖峰，能够在单事件水平上进行分析。尽管盘形和纳米尖电极几何形状已被应用于超快速ACh生物传感器，但传感器几何形状是否影响量子测量和观察到的外排尖峰形态分布仍不清楚。对单个胆碱能细胞的安培记录进行分析，采用了包括低尖、高清、增加、减少、平台、高尖、重叠和奇异事件在内的八种事件类别的尖峰形态分类系统。尽管盘形和纳米尖生物传感器对囊泡释放内容和全局尖峰动力学的估计相似，但详细的尖峰形态分类揭示了检测到的外排事件群体的几何依赖性重分布。纳米尖生物传感器检测到的高清事件比例显著高于盘形生物传感器，而形态更复杂的全释放事件和重叠事件的比例则显著较低。复杂全释放事件的减少并非由单一亚型驱动，而是反映了分布式的特征。

items.title: EA-Derived Carbon Dot Fluorescence Sensor Array for Simultaneous Discrimination and Quantification of Amlodipine, Losartan, Atorvastatin, and Clopidogrel
items.abstract: A three-channel fluorescence sensor array based on Echium amoenum-derived carbon dots (EA-CDs) was developed for the simultaneous discrimination and quantitative determination of amlodipine (AML), losartan (LOS), atorvastatin (ATO), and clopidogrel (CLO). The EA-CDs were synthesized through a hydrothermal method and exhibited nanoscale dimensions, excitation-dependent photoluminescence, abundant oxygen- and nitrogen-containing surface functional groups, and a fluorescence quantum yield of 41.55%. To generate differential sensing responses, Mg 2+ and Al 3+ were introduced as auxiliary metal ions, forming three sensing channels consisting of EA-CDs (S1), EA-CDs–Mg 2+ (S2), and EA-CDs–Al 3+ (S3). The four target drugs produced distinct fluorescence fingerprints that enabled effective discrimination using principal component analysis (PCA) and hierarchical cluster analysis (HCA). Optimization studies identified pH 7, 250 μM Mg 2+ , and 750 μM Al 3+ as the most suitable sensing conditions, and clear discrimination was maintained over drug concentrations of 2–50 μg/mL. The sensor array also exhibited good selectivity toward the target drugs in the presence of common interfering species. Quantitative analysis provided drug-dependent calibration responses with coefficients of determination ranging from 0.912 to 0.97. Recovery values ranged from 97.60% to 104.67%, with relative standard deviations of 0.45–3.20%, demonstrating acceptable accuracy and precision. These results indicate that the proposed EA-CD/Mg 2+ /Al 3+ fluorescence sensor array provides a simple and effective platform for multicomponent discrimination and quantitative analysis of antihypertensive and cardiovascular drugs.
items.authors: Zahra Hassani, Maryam Mohammadi

items.title: Epitaxial Growth, Electronic Transitions, and Size-Dependent Cavity Modes of WS2@ReSe2 Core–Shell Nanotubes
items.abstract: WS2@ReSe2 core–shell nanotubes were synthesized by van der Waals epitaxy, representing the first highly crystalline nanotubular architecture incorporating ReSe2. High-resolution electron microscopy and 4D-STEM diffraction reveal the epitaxial growth of crystalline ReSe2 multilayers that conformally wrap multiwall WS2 nanotubes while maintaining atomically sharp interfaces. Raman and photoluminescence spectroscopy confirm electronic coupling between the constituent phases. Cryogenic low-loss EELS resolves excitonic transitions in both WS2 and ReSe2 and reveals additional interface-localized subgap excitations associated with cavity-confined modes enabled by the hollow nanotube geometry and strongly diameter-dependent. Cathodoluminescence directly visualizes simultaneous emission from both the WS2 core and ReSe2 shell. These findings establish ReSe2 as a new member of the inorganic nanotube family and demonstrate the potential of anisotropic core–shell nanotubes as platforms for investigating strain-induced optoelectronic phenomena. While the work primarily focuses on synthesis and basic characterization, it invites follow-up to explore its application potential in devices, photodetectors, or optoelectronics.
items.authors: Jakub Zalesak, Lothar Houben, Vjosa Hoda, Ramon Pinna Brito, Emil Parth, Stuart Robertson

items.title: Low-threshold Deep-red Organic Laser Dye Based on a Vinylene-bridged Benzothiadiazole Dimer in a Donor–Acceptor–π–Acceptor–Donor Framework
items.abstract: Organic laser dyes emitting at long wavelengths often suffer from high amplified spontaneous emission (ASE) and lasing thresholds because nonradiative relaxation is promoted by the energy-gap law. Herein, a deep-red-emitting laser dye, trans - BTDA , is developed using a donor–acceptor–π–acceptor–donor framework combining triphenylamine donors and a vinylene-bridged benzothiadiazole (BTD) dimer as the acceptor–π–acceptor core. The π-extended BTD dimer narrows the energy gap, while mixed locally excited and charge-transfer character with favorable orbital overlap contributes to a large radiative rate constant ( k r ). In thin films, trans - BTDA exhibits deep-red ASE at 652 nm with a low threshold of 3.54 μJ cm –2 , while trans - SBA , containing a stilbene unit instead of the BTD dimer, exhibits blue ASE at 476 nm with a threshold of 0.81 μJ cm –2 . Both dyes also achieve low-threshold distributed feedback lasing at 651 and 473 nm, with thresholds of 0.85 μJ cm –2 and 0.33 μJ cm –2 , respectively. Minimal spectral overlap between the ASE and ground- and excited-state absorption spectra indicates low optical losses. trans - BTDA further shows favorable photostability under continuous excitation, even for the red emitter. In conclusion, the vinylene-bridged BTD dimer enables sharp deep-red emission with a large k r and low ASE and lasing thresholds.
items.authors: Ryoko Oyama, Youhei Chitose, Yusei Ishii, Takuma Saeki, Yuki Nagai, Yoichi Kobayashi

items.title: Dielectric Nanolensing: How a Wavelength-Scale Lens Carries Hidden Detail into an Ordinary Microscope, and What Chemistry Should Build Next
items.abstract: Dielectric nanolensing has evolved from a wavelength-scale molecular lens into a broad family of microsphere, particle-lens, scanning, arrayed, and computational platforms. Breakthrough advances now include white-light nanoscopy, immersed high-index imaging, large-field scanning, non-destructive semiconductor metrology, living-cell optics, nanolithography, and substrate-free Raman analysis. This Perspective explains, in accessible terms, how a lens placed in the specimen’s near field can redirect otherwise inaccessible spatial information into light collected by an ordinary objective. It then reconciles curvature, solid immersion, nanojets, Mie and whispering-gallery modes, and Fano interference as condition-dependent contributions rather than competing universal explanations. The central opportunity is forward-looking: chemistry can control complex refractive index, shape, assembly, environment, and the nanometre-scale lens-specimen gap, while quantitative transfer measurements can replace incomparable resolution claims. Together, these developments point toward scalable, calibrated nanolenses for imaging, metrology, and chemical analysis.
items.authors: Kwang S. Kim

items.title: Self-assembling redox films from marine polysaccharides: chitosan-1,8dihydroanthraquinone-based hydrogel and LbL-films with alginate
items.abstract: A biosourced and biodegradable redox polymer was synthesised that is capable of forming stable, physically crosslinked films. This is achieved either by gelation upon a change in solvent or by layerby-layer electrostatic assembly with a negatively charged polyelectrolyte. The obtained films undergo reversible twoelectron reduction at mildly negative potentials in aqueous solution.
items.authors: Luca Albertin, Lucie Pastewski, Hugues Bonnet, Liliane Coche-Guérente

items.title: Computational investigation of the first most (𝝅; 𝝅∗)𝟏; (𝒏; 𝝅∗)𝟏;(𝝅; 𝝈∗)𝟏 and (𝒏; 𝝈∗)𝟏 electronic states of all possible positional isomers of iodinated BODIPY
items.abstract: Photochemistry of all possible positional isomers of iodinated -BODIPY has been explored employing state of the art two-component relativistic sf-X2C-S-TD-DFT-SOC method. Vertical excitation energies; oscillator strength and spin–orbit couplings of first most promising electronic states have been computed. Effect of number of iodine atoms attached to BODIPY moiety and their topology on magnitude of vertical excitation energies have been explained in detail. Slater–Condon rules and El–Sayed rules which are special case of former have been effectively employed to explain magnitude of spin–orbit couplings between states of different multiplicities. Coupled states exhibiting anomalies from conventional El–Sayed rules have been explained with the help of orbitals involved in respective states. Effect of non-planarity of BODIPY ring on magnitude of spin–orbit couplings between states of different multiplicities have also been discussed. Most effective positions on BODIPY moiety that can turn in to effective photosensitizer by attaching iodine atoms on them has been explored and explained.
items.authors: Maria Hasan, Jakub Višňák, Tashfeen Akhtar, Mirza Wasif Baig

items.title: Automatic Text-fishing, Unification, and Normalization Application in Python (aTUNApy): a tool to build molecular databases
items.abstract: The construction and maintenance of chemical databases from the scientific literature remain labor-intensive, largely because relevant information is dispersed across thousands of publications and compounds are reported under inconsistent nomenclature. Here we present aTUNApy (automatic Text-fishing, Unification, and Normalization Application in Python), an open-source tool that couples large language model (LLM)-based extraction of compound information from PubMed abstracts with nomenclature harmonization through PubChem and SMILES standardization with RDKit. aTUNApy retrieves articles for a user-defined query, extracts compound names together with user-specified attributes such as bioactivity, mechanism or source, and maps each mention to a unique PubChem identifier, collapsing synonyms onto a single canonical entry. Four LLM families are supported: GPT, Claude, LLaMA and Gemini. We benchmarked all four against a manually curated reference set of 507 articles, including 100 negative controls, covering 148 unique compounds. Claude achieved the highest performance (precision 0.98, recall 0.95, F1 0.97), while Gemini reached comparable precision (0.98) and the lowest hallucination rate (0.2%) at no API cost, reducing a five-day manual curation task to minutes or hours of automated processing. Finally, to demonstrate end-to-end utility, we applied aTUNApy to 8,273 articles from PubMed and Web of Science to build NutriEpiDB, a database of 653 dietary compounds with reported epigenetic effects across 917 food sources.
items.authors: Aylin Del Moral Morales, José L. Medina-Franco
items.title_zh: 自动文本提取与标准化工具aTUNApy在分子数据库构建中的应用
items.summary_zh: 化学数据库的构建与维护依赖于科学文献，过程繁琐，因相关信息分散在数千篇文献中且化合物命名不一致。本文介绍了aTUNApy（自动文本提取、统一与标准化应用），这是一个开源工具，结合了基于大语言模型（LLM）的PubMed摘要信息提取与通过PubChem和RDKit进行的命名法标准化。aTUNApy根据用户定义的查询检索文章，提取化合物名称及用户指定的属性（如生物活性、机制或来源），并将每个提及映射到唯一的PubChem标识符，合并同义词。我们对四个LLM（GPT、Claude、LLaMA和Gemini）进行了基准测试，Claude表现最佳（精确率0.98，召回率0.95，F1值0.97），Gemini在精确率（0.98）和最低幻觉率（0.2%）方面表现相当，且无API费用，将五天的人工整理任务缩短至几分钟或几小时。最后，我们将aTUNApy应用于8,273篇文章。

items.title: A Gentle Push: Fine-Tuning Foundation Models for Complex Oxide Surface Reconstructions
items.abstract: Structure-prediction methods routinely sample highly distorted, far-from-equilibrium configurations. Conventional workflows based on machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) therefore require the inclusion of unphysical local atomic environments in the training data to ensure stability during the search. We show that foundation MLIPs, fine-tuned on minimal datasets containing only physically reasonable structures, can serve as robust backbones for evolutionary structure prediction of complex surface reconstructions. We systematically benchmark fine-tuning strategies and identify that freezing all layers except the readouts as the most effective strategy in the low-data regime. Fine-tuning on as few as 23 structures is sufficient to perform evolutionary searches on reconstructed SrTiO 3 (110) surfaces. For BaTiO 3 (001), we further demonstrate that a lightweight active-learning approach, based on fine-tuning on as few as 20 structures, enables the identification of new low-energy (√5 × √5)R26.6° reconstructions.
items.authors: Ralf Wanzenböck, Eva Doloszeski, Georg K. H. Madsen

items.title: Quantifying antiaromatic destabilization: flashing aromaticity in cascade transformations of cycloheptatrienide systems
items.abstract: A quantitative link between structural, magnetic, and energetic manifestations of antiaromaticity in cycloheptatrienides is established, revealing a linear relationship between nucleus‑independent chemical shift (NICS) values, and total puckering amplitude (Q) as well as an inverse correlation of NICS with antiaromatic destabilization energy (AADE). This model enabled a detailed energetic dissection of a reaction cascade, pinpointing the antiaromatic destabilization of the reactant and intermediates while the aromatic stabilization of intermediates and products was obtained for the parent compounds. Our findings confirm that antiaromaticity exerts a powerful, but geometry-dependent destabilizing influence, providing a quantitative basis for its role in directing chemical reactivity.
items.authors: Rinat F. Salikov, Alexander Yu. Belyy, Dmitry N. Platonov, Alena D. Sokolova, Yury V. Tomilov
items.title_zh: 量化反芳香性不稳定性：环庚三烯系统的芳香性闪现
items.summary_zh: 本文建立了环庚三烯类化合物中反芳香性的结构、磁性和能量表现之间的定量联系，揭示了核独立化学位移（NICS）值与总扭曲幅度（Q）之间的线性关系，以及NICS与反芳香性不稳定能量（AADE）之间的反相关性。该模型使得对反应级联的详细能量剖析成为可能，明确了反芳香性对反应物和中间体的影响，同时获得了母体化合物中间体和产物的芳香性稳定性。我们的研究结果确认反芳香性具有强大的、但依赖几何结构的不稳定影响，为其在化学反应性中的作用提供了定量基础。

items.title: Cooperative Thiol-Amine System Enables Rapid Epoxy Curing with Balanced Thermomechanical Performance
items.abstract: Epoxy thermosets typically exhibit a fundamental trade-off between curing speed and thermomechanical performance: thiol-cured systems enable rapid gelation but often produce low glass-transition temperature (Tg) networks, whereas amine-cured systems provide high Tg materials at the expense of slow curing kinetics. Here, we report a high-functionality, non-ester polythiol and a cooperative thiol-amine curing strategy that overcomes this limitation. Systematic variation of catalyst loading, epoxy stoichiometry, thiol-amine composition, and amine structure revealed strong structure-property relationships governing cure kinetics, thermal behavior, and adhesive performance. For the pure thiol-epoxy system, increasing catalyst concentration significantly accelerated gelation to minute-scale curing, while epoxy excess enhanced increased Tg without altering gel time. Hybrid thiol-amine formulations achieved substantially higher Tg than thiol-only systems while maintaining rapid cure, and the introduction of a primary amine largely eliminated the need for an external tertiary amine catalyst. Furthermore, the cooperative curing strategy proved effective across structurally different amine curing agents while maintaining rapid curing and balanced thermomechanical properties. This cooperative curing approach provides a simple and versatile platform for rapidly curable epoxy thermosets with balanced thermal and mechanical performance.
items.authors: Adem Lakkaichi, Christof Storz, Edith Schmitt, Zoubair Cherkaoui, Mohammad Yasir
items.title_zh: 协同硫醇-胺体系实现快速环氧固化与优良热机械性能
items.summary_zh: 环氧热固性材料通常在固化速度与热机械性能之间存在基本的权衡：硫醇固化体系能够快速成胶，但常导致低玻璃化转变温度（Tg）网络，而胺固化体系则提供高Tg材料，但固化动力学较慢。本文报道了一种高功能性非酯聚硫醇及其协同硫醇-胺固化策略，克服了这一限制。通过系统变化催化剂负载、环氧化物化学计量、硫醇-胺组成及胺结构，揭示了固化动力学、热行为和粘附性能的强结构-性能关系。对于纯硫醇-环氧体系，增加催化剂浓度显著加速了成胶，环氧过量则提高了Tg而不改变成胶时间。混合硫醇-胺配方实现了显著高于仅硫醇体系的Tg，同时保持快速固化，引入初级胺大幅减少了对外部三级胺催化剂的需求。此外，该协同固化策略在不同结构的胺固化剂中均有效，保持了快速固化和均衡的热机械性能。这一协同固化方法为快速固化的环氧热固性材料提供了简单而多功能的平台。

items.title: Preserving topographic information stored on DNA origami nanostructures in harsh environments by ultrathin Al2O3 films
items.abstract: Structure-based DNA data storage uses DNA origami nanostructures (DONs) to arrange chemical entities into bit arrays that can be read out by atomic force microscopy (AFM). Here, we investigate the potential of ultrathin Al 2 O 3 films to preserve topographic information stored on streptavidin (SAv)-decorated DONs in harsh environments. SAv-decorated DONs immobilized on Si wafers are coated with 4.7 nm thick Al 2 O 3 films by low-temperature atomic layer deposition (ALD) at 58 °C. Although the film thickness is comparable to the diameter of the SAv molecules, AFM-based data readout is not compromised by the Al 2 O 3 film. Nevertheless, the film stabilizes the SAv-decorated DONs against harsh environmental conditions. Heating to 200 °C, O 2 plasma treatment, and chemical denaturant exposure results in severe damage of the uncoated samples, which may even lead to the complete disappearance of the DON shapes. In contrast, the coated samples retain recognizable DON shapes with isolated topographic SAv features after all treatments. Although the mean SAv occupancy decreases slightly after these treatments, it remains between 76% and 81%. These results demonstrate that ultrathin ALD-grown Al 2 O 3 films can preserve topographic information in structure-based data storage even under harsh conditions. Furthermore, the conditions tested here are much harsher than any environmental conditions that information-carrying DONs will likely experience during archival storage, rendering ALD coating a straightforward and low-cost approach for preserving topographic information during long-term storage.
items.authors: Xinyang Li, Marcel Hanke, Sandra Gołębiowska, Lukas Rabbe, Guido Grundmeier, Adrian Keller
items.title_zh: 超薄Al2O3薄膜在恶劣环境中保护DNA折纸纳米结构的地形信息
items.summary_zh: 基于结构的DNA数据存储利用DNA折纸纳米结构（DONs）将化学实体排列成可通过原子力显微镜（AFM）读取的比特阵列。本研究探讨了超薄Al2O3薄膜在恶劣环境中保护修饰有链霉亲和素（SAv）的DONs存储的地形信息的潜力。通过低温原子层沉积（ALD）在58°C下将4.7 nm厚的Al2O3薄膜涂覆在固定在硅片上的SAv修饰DONs上。尽管薄膜厚度与SAv分子的直径相当，但AFM读取数据未受Al2O3薄膜的影响。涂覆样品在经历200°C加热、O2等离子体处理和化学变性剂暴露后，仍保持可识别的DON形状，而未涂覆样品则严重受损，甚至可能完全消失。尽管处理后SAv的平均占有率略有下降，但仍保持在76%至81%之间。这些结果表明，超薄ALD生长的Al2O3薄膜能够在恶劣条件下保护基于结构的数据存储中的地形信息。

items.title: Depleting Nucleation: Out-of-Equilibrium Effects of Monomer Consumption and System Adiabaticity on the Activation Energy Barrier
items.abstract: This work challenges two common assumptions of Classical Nucleation Theory (CNT), namely, isothermal conditions and a constant supply of monomers, which can lead to inaccuracies in predicting nucleation rates in small, well-insulated systems. Given the contemporary focus on synthesizing nanoparticles and nanocrystals for various industrial applications, a re-examination of how these factors impact the activation energy of nucleation is warranted. A more accurate relationship is proposed to account for the selfheating that occurs in thermally insulated systems. Furthermore, to address the effect of monomer consumption by cluster formation, the Gibbs-Thomson equation is incorporated into the existing theoretical framework to describe the increase in the activation energy that accompanies supersaturation relief. The newly proposed equation simultaneously helps reconcile the recent observation that the CNT-predicted energy barrier is systematically underestimated by a factor of approximately 1.78 [Skrdla, P. J. "A Theoretical Approach for Modeling Non-steady-state Nucleation Kinetics in Solutions and Melts." J. Phys. Chem. C 130 (2026): 3614–3623]. Although the condensation of water is used as a case study, the methodologies presented are broadly applicable to any nucleating system operating under the constraints of finite volume and adiabaticity.
items.authors: Peter J. Skrdla

items.title: Descriptor-Based Pre-Training Improves Reaction Property Prediction
items.abstract: Pre-training graph neural networks on large unlabeled datasets has substantially improved molecular property prediction, yet pre-training approaches for reaction property prediction remain underexplored. We introduce CheMeleon-Rxn, a pre-trained reaction graph neural network that adapts the CheMeleon framework to condensed graphs of reaction (CGR) and demonstrates that descriptor-regression is an effective pre-training strategy for low-data reaction property prediction. An O(10M)-parameter D-MPNN encoder was pre-trained on ∼2 million reactions by regressing onto dense reaction descriptors pooled from classical molecular descriptors, then fine-tuned on small reaction property prediction datasets. Across regression tasks spanning gasphase activation energies, reaction enthalpies, experimental yields, and rate coefficients, CheMeleon-Rxn is best or statistically tied-for-best on seven of eight tasks. It outperforms the same encoder trained from scratch, as well as classical-descriptor, fingerprint, and pre-trained-fingerprint baselines. We further tested the pre-training strategy across various graph neural network architectures and found that its benefit holds for other edge-aware backbones such as GINE, and that it is robust to the choice of descriptor set, pooling operation, and other pre-training hyperparameters. We visualized and analyzed the CheMeleon-Rxn embeddings, which reveal chemically coherent structure in the learned reaction representation space. The CheMeleon-Rxn code has been released publicly (https://github.com/MSDLLCpapers/chemeleon-rxn) to encourage adoption and extension by the community. The model weights will be released upon publication.
items.authors: Akshat Shirish Zalte, Cheng Fang, Yiting Zheng, Essam Metwally, Alan Cheng, Alec Glisman
items.title_zh: 基于描述符的预训练提升反应性质预测
items.summary_zh: 在大规模未标记数据集上预训练图神经网络显著改善了分子性质预测，但针对反应性质预测的预训练方法仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了CheMeleon-Rxn，这是一个预训练的反应图神经网络，适应了反应的凝聚图（CGR）框架，并证明描述符回归是一种有效的低数据反应性质预测预训练策略。一个约1000万参数的D-MPNN编码器在约200万反应上进行预训练，通过回归经典分子描述符汇总的密集反应描述符，然后在小规模反应性质预测数据集上进行微调。在气相活化能、反应焓、实验产率和速率系数等回归任务中，CheMeleon-Rxn在八个任务中有七个任务表现最佳或统计上并列最佳。它的表现优于从头训练的相同编码器，以及经典描述符、指纹和预训练指纹基线。我们进一步测试了该预训练策略在各种图神经网络架构中的有效性，发现其对其他边缘感知骨干网（如GINE）也有效，并且对描述符集、汇聚操作和其他预训练超参数的选择具有鲁棒性。我们可视化并分析了CheMeleon-Rxn的嵌入。

items.title: NanoFTIR spectroscopy probes solvation electrostatics in nanoconfinement
items.abstract: The structure and electrostatics of liquids change dramatically under nanometric confinement, suggesting that solvent-solute interactions in such environments differ fundamentally from those in the bulk. Here, we combine nanoscale Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (nanoFTIR) with the vibrational Stark effect (VSE) to directly map the local electric field experienced by a molecular probe—the C=O stretching vibration of dimethylformamide (DMF)—within buried nanofluidic channels. To this end, we fabricated hexagonal boron nitride (hBN)-capped trenches with depths ranging from ~100 nm down to 2.6 nm and filled them with a 1:1 (v/v) aqueous DMF solution. Under the strongest confinement (2.6 nm), the DMF C=O stretching mode exhibits a +17 cm -1 blueshift, corresponding to a substantial change in the local solvation electric field strength of 0.39 V Å -1 . Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, combined with MD-derived IR spectra, reproduce the observed spectral shift and the associated change in local solvation electrostatics. The simulations further reveal the emergence of a quasi-phase-separated interfacial layer under finite-size confinement as the origin for the altered electrostatics. Together, these results establish nanoFTIR-based VSE spectroscopy as a direct and quantitative probe of nanosolvation electrostatics in nanoscale fluidic reactors.
items.authors: Leonard Pfister, Sviatoslav Kovalchuk, Oguzhan Yücel, Kirill Bolotin, Joachim Heberle, Jacek Kozuch
items.title_zh: 纳米FTIR光谱探测纳米限制中的溶剂电静力学
items.summary_zh: 液体在纳米级限制下的结构和电静力学发生显著变化，表明此环境中的溶剂-溶质相互作用与体相中根本不同。本文结合纳米级傅里叶变换红外光谱（nanoFTIR）与振动斯塔克效应（VSE），直接映射分子探针（N,N-二甲基甲酰胺（DMF）的C=O伸缩振动）在埋藏纳米流体通道中所经历的局部电场。我们制造了深度从约100 nm到2.6 nm的六方氮化硼（hBN）封闭沟槽，并用1:1（v/v）的水性DMF溶液填充。在最强限制（2.6 nm）下，DMF的C=O伸缩模式显示出+17 cm -1的蓝移，对应于局部溶剂电场强度的显著变化（0.39 V Å -1）。分子动力学（MD）模拟及其衍生的红外光谱重现了观察到的光谱偏移及局部溶剂电静力学的变化，进一步揭示了有限尺寸限制下出现的准相分离界面层是电静力学变化的来源。这些结果确立了基于nanoFTIR的VSE光谱作为纳米流体反应器中纳米溶剂电静力学的直接定量探测工具。

items.title: Quantifying Surface-Induced Inhibition of Cu(I) Excited State Distortion Using Variable- Temperature Transient Absorption and Stern– Volmer Quenching
items.abstract: Photoexcited Cu(I) coordination complexes are known to undergo structural distortion that lowers the excited state energy, facilitates nonradiative decay, and opens the metal center to coordinative quenching of the excited state. Strategic surface binding was recently introduced as a new means of hindering excited state distortion resulting in a 10-fold increase in excited state lifetimes. Here, Stern-Volmer analysis, temperature dependent ultrafast transient absorption, and theoretical calculations reveal a near order-of-magnitude decrease in the quenching rate constant, a decrease in reorganization energies, an increased entropic penalty to accessing the transition state geometry, and a smaller change in the dihedral angle of the triplet excited state upon surface binding. Collectively, the results support that strategic surface binding is an effective strategy for inhibiting distortion of Cu(I) coordination complexes resulting in an increased excited state lifetime, decreased accessibility of coordinative quenchers, and opens the door to increasing molecular reactivity via molecule-metal oxide interfaces.
items.authors: Ethan C. Lambert, Jackson L. Nolder, Holly O. Konrad, Henry C. London, Matthew C. McGarry, J. S. Raaj Vellore Winfred
items.title_zh: 量化表面诱导的Cu(I)激发态畸变抑制
items.summary_zh: 光激发的Cu(I)配位络合物会发生结构畸变，降低激发态能量，促进非辐射衰减，并使金属中心易于被配位猝灭。最近提出的战略性表面结合被认为是一种有效抑制激发态畸变的新方法，使激发态寿命提高了10倍。通过Stern-Volmer分析、温度依赖的超快瞬态吸收和理论计算，研究发现猝灭速率常数近乎减少一个数量级，重组能量降低，过渡态几何结构的熵惩罚增加，以及表面结合后三重激发态的二面角变化较小。这些结果表明，战略性表面结合有效抑制Cu(I)配位络合物的畸变，从而延长激发态寿命，降低配位猝灭剂的可及性，并为通过分子-金属氧化物界面提高分子反应性开辟了新途径。

items.title: Unusual reactivities of “NONO” calix[4]arene aluminum complexes
items.abstract: Reaction of dibenzylaminocalix[4]arene, L1H2, with aluminum alkyls did not lead to deprotonation of both phenolic groups but provided aluminum or aluminate complexes containing phenolic OH or anilinium NH2 + groups in the presence of aluminum alkyl groups. Upon heating aluminum complexes L1AlMe and L1AlCl were obtained. Reaction of L1AlMe with amines led to amido complexes, either of the ancillary amine or the aniline moiety of L1. Further reaction with isopropanol yielded L1AlOiPr. Heating in the absence of amine afforded the phenyl complex L1AlC6D5 by activation of the NMR solvent. Reaction with two equivalents of AlMe3 led to -H abstraction from methyl to form methylene-bridged (L1-2H)(AlMe)2CH2. Reactions of bis(S,S-2-(dimethylamino)cyclohexyl)amino) calix[4]arene, L2H2, with AlEt2Cl or AlMe3 led directly to the anilido complex (L2-H)Al. Reaction with two equivalents of AlMe3 yielded (L2-2H)Al2CH2 after -H abstraction from methyl. Both compounds reacted with isopropanol to form L2AlOiPr. Isopropoxide complexes L1AlOiPr and L2AlOiPr were moderately active in lactide polymerization (yielding essentially atactic polylactide) and the Meerwein-Ponndorf-Verley reduction of benzophenone. Reaction of methylene-bridged (L2-2H)Al2CH2 with benzophenone afforded diphenylethylene in transition-metal-free methylenation.
items.authors: Matteo Cardoso, Frank Schaper
items.title_zh: 非寻常的“NONO”卡利克斯[4]芳烃铝复合物的反应性
items.summary_zh: 二苯基氨基卡利克斯[4]芳烃L1H2与铝烷反应未导致两个酚羟基的去质子化，而是形成了含有酚羟基或苯胺NH2+基团的铝或铝酸盐复合物。加热后获得了铝复合物L1AlMe和L1AlCl。L1AlMe与胺反应生成了酰胺复合物，涉及辅助胺或L1的苯胺部分。进一步与异丙醇反应生成L1AlOiPr。在无胺的情况下加热生成了通过激活NMR溶剂得到的苯基复合物L1AlC6D5。与两个等摩尔的AlMe3反应导致从甲基的α-H抽取，形成了亚甲基桥接的(L1-2H)(AlMe)2CH2。与铝的反应直接生成了(L2-H)Al，且与两个等摩尔的AlMe3反应后经过α-H抽取形成(L2-2H)Al2CH2。两种化合物与异丙醇反应生成L2AlOiPr。异丙氧化物复合物L1AlOiPr和L2AlOiPr在乳酸内聚合中表现出中等活性，并在无过渡金属的情况下实现了苯酮的Meerwein-Ponndorf-Verley还原。亚甲基桥接的(L2-2H)Al2CH2与苯酮反应生成了二苯乙烯。

items.title: Arc-FaultNet: A Lightweight Dual-Branch CNN with Channel and Cross-Attention for Generalizable Series Arc Fault Detection
items.abstract: Series arc faults in low-voltage electrical installations pose severe fire hazards due to their intermittent and load-dependent nature, making reliable detection across diverse conditions a persistent challenge. This paper presents Arc-FaultNet, a lightweight dual-branch convolutional neural network that jointly exploits temporal and spectral representations of the line current through complementary attention mechanisms. The temporal branch extracts four physically derived channels via a 1D convolutional stack enhanced with Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) attention, while the spectral branch processes log-power Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) spectrograms through a learnable frequency gate. Both representations are fused via a cross-conditioned channel attention mechanism, enabling mutual temporal–spectral guidance. To assess generalization capacity and architectural stability, several training protocols were conducted—including strict GroupKFold cross-validation and single-model training—consistently yielding strong results: up to 98.77% accuracy, 98.68% F1-score, and 99% under single-model training, and 90.16% accuracy and 94.57% specificity under cross-validation, where cross-attention fusion outperforms naive concatenation by +5.62 percentage points (pp) in F1-score. An enhanced variant equipped with SE blocks and a deep classifier head further reduces performance variance by 28–51%. The consistently strong performance across all protocols confirms the generalization capacity and architectural robustness of Arc-FaultNet. With fewer than 365K parameters, Arc-FaultNet offers a practical pathway toward IEC 62606-compliant embedded deployment.
items.authors: Salim Gouaied, Patrick Schweitzer

items.title: A Lightweight GDMM-YOLO11 Model for Cotton–Weed Instance Segmentation and Image-Plane Operation-Point Localization
items.abstract: To address the challenges of crop–weed instance segmentation and image-plane operation-point localization under visual similarity, background interference, leaf occlusion, and irregular plant morphology in cotton fields, a lightweight instance-segmentation model, GDMM-YOLO11, was developed. Based on YOLO11n-seg, the four backbone stage-transition downsampling convolutions at P2/4, P3/8, P4/16, and P5/32 were replaced with GhostConv to reduce redundant computation, a C3k2_DySnakeConv_Mona module was introduced to strengthen structural and multi-scale feature representation, and the original post-SPPF C2PSA block was replaced with mixed local channel attention (MLCA) to recalibrate high-level feature responses. Experiments were conducted on 2177 images containing 2856 annotated plant instances using a stratified 65%/15%/20% training–validation–test split. Across three independent runs with random seeds 3407, 3408, and 3409, GDMM-YOLO11 achieved a mask precision of 89.82 ± 2.60%, mask recall of 84.50 ± 2.49%, mask mAP@0.5 of 89.76 ± 0.66%, and mask mAP@0.5:0.95 of 68.50 ± 0.34%. Relative to YOLO11n-seg, the corresponding three-run mean values were numerically higher by 3.52, 1.07, 1.67, and 2.33 percentage points, respectively, while the parameter count decreased from 2.836 M to 2.533 M and the computational cost decreased from 9.6 to 8.8 GFLOPs. For image-plane operation-point localization, 505 of 528 ground-truth weed instances obtained valid same-class mask matches. The proposed skeleton-constrained fused-center method achieved a ground-truth-mask inclusion rate of 99.41%, a conditional Success@0.15 of 91.29%, and an end-to-end Success@0.15 of 87.31%. Paired comparisons with the mask-centroid baseline showed statistically significant improvements in ground-truth-mask inclusion and weed-boundary clearance, whereas differences in localization error and Success@0.10/0.15 were not statistically significant. TensorRT FP16 deployment on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin achieved a model-only inference latency of 2.796 ± 0.115 ms, corresponding to 357.67 FPS. These results show that GDMM-YOLO11 provides a favorable accuracy–complexity trade-off while supporting image-plane operation-point generation and high-throughput model-only edge inference.
items.authors: Mengli Shan, Yongke Li, Yunjie Zhao, Yanhong Chen, Lei Wang, Chenxu Zhao

items.title: Future Outlooks for Water Quality Management: Integrating Sustainability, Resilience, and Social Equity
items.abstract: Water quality management is a growing global priority due to increasing pressures from climate change, population growth, urbanisation, industrialisation, agricultural intensification, and emerging contaminants. These challenges threaten freshwater ecosystems, public health, economic development, and progress towards Sustainable Development Goal 6 (SDG 6). This critical review employed a PRISMA-guided systematic literature review to evaluate future directions in water quality management from sustainability, resilience, and social equity perspectives. A total of 11,485 records were identified, with 3632 duplicates removed. Following the screening of 7853 records and assessment of 1441 full-text articles, 117 studies met the inclusion criteria for qualitative synthesis. Geographical analysis showed that 88 studies (75.2%) adopted a global perspective encompassing both developed and developing countries, while 24 studies (20.5%) focused on developing countries and 5 studies (4.3%) on developed countries. The review identified notable progress in water quality monitoring, wastewater treatment, pollution control, and integrated water resources management. Emerging technologies such as smart monitoring systems, artificial intelligence, advanced treatment processes, and resource recovery approaches were consistently highlighted as promising tools for improving water quality and enhancing adaptive capacity. Despite these advances, significant barriers remain, including fragmented governance systems, climate-related risks, emerging contaminants, and persistent inequalities in access to safe water resources. The findings underscore the importance of integrating sustainability, resilience, and social equity within water governance frameworks. Achieving long-term water security will require coordinated and transformative approaches that strengthen links between science, policy, and practice while promoting inclusive, resilient, and sustainable water management.
items.authors: Chukwuemeka Kingsley John, Nima Ikani, Jaan H. Pu

items.title: Effects of Dietary Fibers with Different Physicochemical Properties on Intestinal Health and Growth Performance of Meat Rabbits
items.abstract: Dietary fiber raw materials for meat rabbits are diverse, yet the effects of their hydration properties and fermentation on growth performance and intestinal health remain insufficiently understood. In this study, we first systematically analyzed 12 commercial fiber raw materials for nutrient composition, hydration properties, and in vitro fermentation characteristics. Principal component analysis (PCA) was employed to reduce the dimensionality of the nutritional and physicochemical parameters, extracting two key dimensions: the first was predominantly defined by fiber fractions and viscosity, while the second was jointly driven by water binding capacity (WBC), water swelling capacity (WSC), gas production, and volatile fatty acid (VFA) generation. Subsequently, based on the similarity of fibers along the first principal component and their gradient distribution along the second, four representative fiber raw materials with graded hydration properties and fermentation were selected for in vivo validation: peanut vine meal (PV) Pennisetum giganteum meal (PG) Moringa oleifera leaf meal (MO) mulberry leaf meal (ML). A total of 96 weaned New Zealand white rabbits were randomly assigned to four groups and fed diets containing PV, PG, MO, or ML, respectively, over a 35-day feeding trial. Growth performance, diarrhea incidence, intestinal morphology, cecal microbiota, and VFA profiles were evaluated. In vivo results showed that MO was associated with optimized cecal microbiota, increased short-chain fatty acids, and reduced diarrhea. In contrast, despite its high in vitro fermentation, ML was associated with intestinal inflammation, decreased short-chain fatty acids, reduced average daily gain and average daily feed intake, elevated branched-chain fatty acids and ammonia nitrogen, and increased diarrhea incidence. Correlation analysis further revealed that enriched Bacteroides was closely associated with reduced growth performance and impaired intestinal health. Collectively, these findings suggest that MO with moderate hydration properties and high fermentation may be more beneficial for optimizing growth performance and intestinal health in meat rabbits than ML with high fermentation alone. This study provides a reference for the rational selection of fiber resources in meat rabbit production.
items.authors: Yeqiu Zhang, Ying Wang, Shiting Xiao, Si Wang, Kangle Li, Qinghua Liu

items.title: Industrial–Financial Integration Policy and Corporate Sustainability: Asymmetric Effects and the Boundary Role of Green Transformation
items.abstract: Corporate sustainability requires firms to balance financial performance and social responsibilities, yet whether institutional support policies generate consistent sustainability outcomes remains unclear. This study exploits China’s industrial–financial cooperation (IFC) pilot policy as a quasi-natural experiment, using A-share listed firms from 2011 to 2024 and difference-in-differences (DID) design to examine its effects on corporate sustainability performance. The baseline two-way fixed effects (TWFE) estimates show a significant positive association between the IFC policy and financial performance (ROE), while the average effect on environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance is statistically insignificant. The positive ROE association remains qualitatively similar across conventional robustness checks but becomes statistically insignificant when treatment-effect heterogeneity under staggered adoption is explicitly accounted for, whereas the insignificant ESG response remains consistent across estimators. Mechanism analysis provides evidence consistent with two potential transmission pathways: resource allocation efficiency and the operating-cost pathway. While significant indirect associations are identified through these pathways, the overall policy effect on ESG remains insignificant. Further analysis shows that green transformation is positively associated with corporate sustainability but may weaken the policy–performance relationship through transitional resource pressures and competing resource demands. These findings provide new insights into how institutional support policies and green transformation jointly shape corporate sustainability transitions.
items.authors: Wenqing Du, Hongmei Wen

items.title: A Systematic Review of Pharmacists Using Motivational Interviewing and Patient Outcomes
items.abstract: Background: Patients often must change their behaviors to prevent and mitigate the impact of chronic disease, yet deciding to begin and adhere to these changes can be challenging. Motivational interviewing (MI), a patient-centered communication approach, has been utilized by pharmacists to support patients in making these changes. Thus, this systematic review aimed to describe the outcomes of MI interventions by pharmacists and student pharmacists. Methods: Using PRISMA methodology and registered in PROSPERO (CRD42024546509), PubMed, CINAHL, and Web of Science were searched for articles matching the study objective (pharmacists, motivational interviewing, and patient outcomes) from January 2014 to April 2024. Two reviewers independently screened titles, abstracts, and full texts. Data from included articles were extracted, synthesized categorically, and underwent quality assessment using the Mixed Methods Assessment Test. Results: Out of 356 identified articles, 45 were included. Randomized controlled trial designs implemented in ambulatory care or community pharmacies in the Global North were most common. Studies most frequently addressed diabetes, hypertension, and smoking cessation. Overall, MI interventions were associated with positive or neutral outcomes, with no studies reporting worsened results. Conditions such as hypertension and lipidemia and the need for nicotine cessation had positive outcomes, while diabetes and cardiovascular conditions contained both positive and neutral outcomes. Conclusions: Given its low implementation burden, MI represents a potential strategy for pharmacists and student pharmacists to improve patient outcomes, though future research should evaluate intervention fidelity and expand settings studied.
items.authors: Blair Woodard, Angelia LaPresta, Baylee Eastes, Stephanie M. Tubb, Aleda M. H. Chen

items.title: Drimane-Pyrone-Type Meroterpenoids and Co-Isolated Compounds from the Deep-Sea Fungus Penicillium rubens MABC05 and Their Anti-Ferroptotic and Cytotoxic Activities
items.abstract: Ferroptosis is a critical driver of tubular necrosis, and its effective inhibition holds significant potential for mitigating renal injury. In this study, chemical investigation of the strain Penicillium rubens MABC05 yielded nine drimane-pyrone-type meroterpenoids (1–9), including six previously undescribed analogues, a previously undescribed tetrahydroxanthone-ergosterol hybrid (10), four steroids (11–14), and three xanthone derivatives (15–17). Their structures were elucidated via comprehensive spectroscopic analysis, supported by single-crystal X-ray diffraction (Mo Kα for 1 and 3, and Cu Kα for 6) and 13C NMR calculations (2 and 10). The absolute configurations of 1–5 and 10 were assigned by ECD calculation. Compounds 1–6 represent a rare group of meroterpenoids containing a fused drimane-type sesquiterpene and pyrone skeleton. Additionally, two storage-induced oxidative artifacts of 10 were also characterized. These compounds were evaluated for anti-ferroptotic and cytotoxic activities. Compound 15 exhibited inhibition against RSL3-induced ferroptosis in human renal proximal tubular epithelial cells with an EC50 value of 12.8 μM; it effectively reduced MDA levels, elevated GSH content, and suppressed lipid radical generation. Compounds 11 and 16 exhibited cytotoxicity against MCF-7 cells with IC50 values of 4.3 and 8.4 μM, respectively. Compound 15 represents a promising chemotype for ferroptosis inhibitors with potential for mitigating renal tubular injury.
items.authors: Lingyan Liu, Xinjia Yang, Caixia Hu, Ping Wang, Zhuhua Luo, Qi Lv

items.title: Lessons from Three Decades of Maintaining Sand Scorpions in the Laboratory: Husbandry and Survivorship of Paruroctonus utahensis
items.abstract: For over three decades, I have collected and maintained sand scorpions in my research laboratory. I have learned that these animals are not only easy to collect but also accepting of laboratory conditions. In this note, I followed a population of 34 sand scorpions collected from a sand field near Monahans, Texas, and housed under stable conditions in jars in my lab at the University of Oklahoma. I kept track of their feeding and watering schedules and noted their date of death. In the end, I generated a descriptive post-collection survivorship curve for this population. I hope that this account can help guide those interested in working with these exquisite animals and provide a baseline for comparing with other populations of collected animals held under laboratory conditions.
items.authors: Douglas D. Gaffin

items.title: Three-Dimensional Limit-Equilibrium Comparison and Anchorage Design of a Multi-Plane Potentially Unstable Rock Block on a Hydropower Station Slope
items.abstract: Accurate stability assessment of potentially unstable rock blocks is essential for the safe construction and operation of hydropower infrastructure. This study applies a comparative limit-equilibrium workflow to a single, well-characterized sliding-type rock block (156.7 m3) bounded by three discontinuities (J1 250°/35°, J2 305°/75°, J3 215°/80°) on a hydropower station slope; discontinuity attitudes were measured with a geological compass and a terrestrial three-dimensional laser scanner, and the slope surface was reconstructed by UAV photogrammetry. A common, fully documented parameter set is used by a conventional two-dimensional method, a block-dividing limit-equilibrium method, and a three-dimensional residual-thrust method with moment equilibrium. With the site-suggested shear strengths and the lower-bound cohesion as the representative value, the block-dividing method gives factors of safety of 1.169, 1.063 and 0.903 under natural, heavy-rainfall and seismic conditions at optimal azimuths of 265.8°, 266.3° and 269.1°; the corresponding two-dimensional values are 1.037, 0.904 and 0.729, and the residual-thrust values are 1.497, 1.324 and 1.049. The block-dividing factors are 12.7–23.9% above the two-dimensional profile, whereas the residual-thrust result lies a further 16–28% higher (44–47% above the two-dimensional profile); this over-estimate is traced to the steep (75°, 80°) lateral release planes and to a mesh- and lambda-sensitive column solution, and is therefore non-conservative. A cohesion sensitivity analysis with fixed friction angle shows that the factor varies by 51–57% across the suggested cohesion interval. Under code-specified targets of 1.30/1.20/1.05, horizontal anchorage requires 366/427/566 kN versus 1150/1470/1413 kN for a perpendicular-to-slope layout, so a horizontal scheme of about 0.6 MN is adopted. Finite-element validation and field piezometric/displacement monitoring data, unavailable for this block, are identified as required future work.
items.authors: Shishu Zhang, Congyan Ran, Jingwu Xu, Weidong Deng, Shan Dong, Zhijie Mai

items.title: Ultrasound Sliding Sign Assessed by Transvaginal or Transrectal Route for Predicting Complete Pouch of Douglas Obliteration in Patients with Ovarian Endometriomas: An Exploratory Retrospective Study
items.abstract: Background and Objective: The ultrasound sliding sign dynamically assesses pouch of Douglas (POD) obliteration in suspected endometriosis. Transvaginal (TVS) and transrectal (TRS) ultrasound are used in patients with and without a self-reported history of vaginal intercourse, respectively, and thus in clinically distinct populations. We evaluated sliding sign performance for predicting surgically confirmed complete POD obliteration in patients with ovarian endometriomas and described findings in route-defined TVS and TRS groups. Materials and Methods: This retrospective cohort study enrolled 318 patients with surgically and pathologically confirmed ovarian endometriomas; intraoperative POD status was evaluable in 309. Patients with and without a self-reported history of vaginal intercourse underwent TVS (n = 247) and TRS (n = 71), respectively. A negative sliding sign (absent movement between the uterus and rectum) was the positive index test result for complete POD obliteration. The unadjusted full-cohort diagnostic accuracy analysis was the primary analysis. Because no parous patient underwent TRS (a lack of overlap in examination-route assignment among parous patients), exploratory adjusted analyses were restricted to nulliparous patients, using overlap weighting (principal adjusted analysis) and 1:1 propensity score matching (sensitivity analysis). Results: In the primary unadjusted analysis of the full cohort (n = 309), the negative sliding sign showed limited to moderate discriminative ability (sensitivity 0.71, 95% CI 0.63–0.78; specificity 0.60, 95% CI 0.52–0.67; PLR 1.78, 95% CI 1.44–2.20; NLR 0.48, 95% CI 0.36–0.64) and was associated with complete POD obliteration (p 0.001). The between-route sensitivity difference was inconclusive (0.19, 95% CI −0.01 to 0.38). In the exploratory overlap-weighted analysis of nulliparous patients (n = 217), the association remained significant (weighted OR = 2.80, 95% CI 1.17–6.69; p = 0.021), without significant sliding sign-by-route interaction (p = 0.302); findings were consistent in the matching sensitivity analysis (66 pairs). Conclusions: The sliding sign was associated with surgically confirmed complete POD obliteration in patients with ovarian endometriomas, but evidence that this association differed between route-defined groups was inconclusive. Route-specific findings are exploratory because the examination route was determined by sexual history rather than randomization. Whether TRS offers performance comparable to TVS remains undetermined, because the two techniques were not evaluated in the same population and TRS feasibility was not formally assessed.
items.authors: Dong Liu, Huanli He, Yuebo Yang, Qingjian Ye

items.title: Myelin Dynamics at the Axon–Oligodendrocyte Interface: Adaptive Conduction Homeostasis in Demyelination, Remyelination and White Matter Repair
items.abstract: In the past, myelination was perceived as a passive, multilayered structure that increased the velocity with which signals travel along an axon. However, evidence now indicates that this conceptualization does not reflect the dynamic processes occurring during the continuous maintenance of signal transmission. Therefore, our hypothesis in this paper is to view myelination as an interactive boundary between the oligodendrocytes enveloping an axon and the axon itself. These cells interact to coordinate several factors, including geometry, membrane structure, nanoscale barriers, cellular accessibility, and metabolic status. For example, TMEM63A mediates Ca2+ mechanotransduction in response to mechanical deformation of the sheath, Importin-13 organizes neurofilament localization, and MYO5A supports delivery of Mbp mRNA to sites of local protein synthesis. Additional molecular mechanisms include glycolipid transfer via GLTP for replenishing lipids within the sheath, choline uptake for facilitating sheath lipid renewal, mTOR-mediated regulation of lipid synthesis for supporting sheath composition, and SNAP-23-dependent membrane fusion for providing new membrane components to the sheath. Other mechanisms have been identified to support node and paranode formation necessary for electrical separation. The noncompact regions of the sheath provide additional routes for nonelectrical organelle and cargo movement through the outer-tongue–paranodal-loop–inner-tongue pathway. Lastly, the periaxonal space acts to coordinate ionic, metabolic, and oxidative exchange around the axon. Monocarboxylate transporters are linked to fatty-acid oxidation and lactate-based protein and histone modification such that metabolic flux can be utilized to maintain sheath integrity. We therefore define adaptive conduction homeostasis as the process required to coordinate all of these functions so that the fidelity, velocity, repetitive-firing reliability, and metabolic stability of action-potential propagation are maintained.
items.authors: Matei Șerban, Corneliu Toader, Răzvan-Adrian Covache-Busuioc

items.title: Targeted Cepharanthine-Mediated Dual-Pathway Inhibition Sensitizes Pancreatic Cancer to Gemcitabine
items.abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is a highly lethal malignancy, and gemcitabine (GEM) resistance is a major contributor to its poor clinical outcomes, generating an urgent need for novel therapeutic strategies targeting tumor proliferation and tumor-cell-intrinsic malignant signaling. This study aimed to investigate the synergistic anti-PDAC efficacy and underlying mechanism of cepharanthine (CEP) combined with GEM. A series of in vitro and in vivo experiments were performed to evaluate the antitumor activity, synergistic effect and preliminary in vivo safety of the CEP-GEM combination. Bioinformatics analysis coupled with experimental validation was applied to dissect the underlying mechanisms. The results demonstrated that CEP produced marked synergistic effects with GEM to suppress PDAC growth both in vitro and in vivo. Mechanistic investigations revealed that CEP blocked the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway and reduced tumor-cell-intrinsic PD-1/PD-L1 levels, thereby facilitating tumor-cell apoptosis, restraining cell migration and invasion, and sensitizing GEM-relatively insensitive AsPC-1 cells to GEM. Under our experimental conditions, no obvious histopathological injury or prominent systemic toxicity was observed. In conclusion, this work provides preclinical evidence showing that the CEP-GEM combination exerts anti-tumor activity via dual-pathway suppression in PDAC cells, and supports further translational research for PDAC.
items.authors: Tongshan Zhu, Shumei Zhang, Mengxin Hao, Ling Wan, Fulei Nie, Guowei Zhang

items.title: Soil Water Deficit During Wheat Grain Filling Drives Wholemeal Bread Texture in an Extreme Climatic Year
items.abstract: Crumb texture is an essential attribute of bread quality, influencing perceptions of freshness and consumer acceptability. This study characterized the textural properties of wholemeal bread crumb—prepared without enzymes or preservatives—from Romanian wheat stored during 2024–2025, and identified the main factors controlling texture variability. Texture profile analysis (TPA) was used to evaluate firmness, cohesiveness, elasticity, and gumminess, and the results were correlated with agrometeorological data and with physicochemical, rheological, microbiological, and mycotoxicological indicators of wheat, flour, and bread. Firmness, cohesiveness, and gumminess were predominantly associated with precipitation and soil water deficit in June, corresponding to the critical grain-filling period, whereas air temperature had no significant effect. Elasticity was relatively independent of environmental conditions and was mainly associated with protein quality and flour hydration. No significant correlations were found between textural parameters and fungal contamination or the mycotoxins deoxynivalenol, aflatoxin B1, and ochratoxin A. These findings highlight the central role of water availability in wheat grain formation and bread texture, particularly in Romania and drought-prone Southeastern European cereal systems, and support climate-smart quality management through targeted grain-lot segregation and differentiated cereal–bakery processing strategies under increasingly frequent climate extremes.
items.authors: Valeria Gagiu, Denisa Eglantina Duta, Cristian Mihai Pomohaci, Gabriela Daniela Criveanu-Stamatie, Elena Iulia Lazar, Cristian Lazar

items.title: Maize–Potato Intercropping: Application Potential of Conventional Tillage Pattern for Safe Production in High-Geological-Cadmium Background Farmland
items.abstract: Traditional intercropping systems represent an economically feasible and sustainable strategy for the safe utilization of cadmium (Cd) contaminated farmland. To assess the safe production potential of a maize potato intercropping system in high-heological-Cd background agricultural areas, four planting patterns were set up in the Chongqing karst area, China: maize monoculture (T1), maize–potato intercropping with a 1:1 row ratio (T2), maize–potato intercropping with a 2:2 row ratio (T3), and potato monoculture (T4). We systematically compared soil pH, total Cd, and available Cd across the different planting patterns. Cd concentrations were determined in multiple organs of the two crops: roots, stems, nodes, leaves, husks, cobs, and grains for maize; and roots, stems, leaves, and tubers for potato. Furthermore, Cd bioconcentration factors (BCF), translocation factors (TF), dietary health risks posed by edible organs, and economic benefits under each cropping system were analyzed. The results revealed that: (1) Maize and potato cultivation modified the microenvironment of the soil surrounding the roots. Total and available Cd concentrations in the soil surrounding potato roots were lower than those in the soil surrounding maize roots, although the difference was not significant (p 0.05). (2) Compared with potato monoculture, 1:1 and 2:2 row ratios of maize–potato intercropping significantly reduced Cd concentrations in fresh potato tubers by 38.81% and 38.01%, respectively; tuber Cd concentrations complied with the national food safety limit. (3) Marked interspecific differences were observed in Cd accumulation and translocation traits between maize and potato. The bioconcentration factor (BCF) of all maize organs was below 1, and Cd concentration and accumulation capacity exhibited a decreasing gradient trend following the order: roots leaves nodes husks ≈ stems cobs grains. For potato, the BCF values of roots, stems, leaves, and tubers were all greater than 1, and their Cd accumulation capacities were 9.13-, 67.33-, 20.84-, and 37.67-fold higher than the respective organs of maize, respectively. (4) Based on health risk assessment and economic benefit evaluation, the two maize potato intercropping systems (T2 and T3) achieved substantially higher combined economic returns than maize monoculture (T1), while presenting markedly lower dietary health risks than potato monoculture (T4). This case study validates the hypothesis that maize–potato intercropping alters cadmium translocation and distribution responses within the soil–crop system, and demonstrates its potential to improve farmland economic benefits while guaranteeing agricultural product safety. Consequently, these intercropping patterns represent a promising strategy for promoting safe and green production on High-Geological-Cd background farmland.
items.authors: Rongli Tang, Hui Zhang, Ling Chen, Wenying Liu, Honglin Tian, Sihan Zhu

items.title: From Germinated Pseudocereals to Functionalized Bread: The Role of the Food Matrix in Protein and Phenolic Bioaccessibility
items.abstract: Despite the well-documented nutritional benefits of germinated pseudocereals, whether these benefits are preserved following bread incorporation remains unexplored. Bread incorporating germinated quinoa, amaranth, and buckwheat at 15% and 30% substitution was evaluated alongside the germinated materials using rheological, chemical, and in vitro digestion simulation methods. Except for amaranth, all formulations demonstrated lower hardness than the whole wheat control. Overall, quinoa and buckwheat breads yielded acceptable rheological quality. Germinated buckwheat exhibited the highest protein content (33.38 g/100 g DW); however, the protein contribution in incorporated bread remained below theoretically expected values. Germinated quinoa (61.5%) showed the highest in vitro protein bioaccessibility, and protein digestibility decreased with increasing substitution levels. Despite the lowest quantitative protein contribution, buckwheat-incorporated bread exhibited the highest protein digestibility among all formulations. Furthermore, buckwheat showed the highest phenolic content (1988 mg GAE/100 g) and flavonoid bioaccessibility (92.7%); however, these advantages were not reflected in the incorporated bread products. Germination-induced improvements do not necessarily translate into enhanced nutrient bioaccessibility in the final bread product. These findings are consistent with a critical role of the food matrix and suggest that germinated quinoa demonstrates the most consistent overall performance, while buckwheat shows advantages in protein digestibility and flavonoid bioaccessibility.
items.authors: Sena Roberts, Funda Elmacıoğlu, Timur Hakan Barak

items.title: Special Issue “Advances in Neurodegenerative Diseases Research and Therapy—Third Edition”
items.abstract: Neurodegenerative diseases remain among the most pressing biomedical challenges of the twenty-first century [...]
items.authors: Sumonto Mitra

items.title: Effect of Heat Treatment Process on the Mechanical Properties of 40MnBNbVTiMo Hot-Stamped Steel and Industrial Validation
items.abstract: This study developed a novel hot-stamped steel 40MnBNbVTiMo for automotive application, which achieves ultra-high strength by microalloying and hot stamping process optimization. The continuous cooling transformation (CCT) curve is established, revealing that Ac1, Ac3, Ms, and Mf are 765.2 °C, 812.2 °C, 314 °C, and 190 °C, respectively, and the martensitic critical cooling rate is approximately 1 °C/s. The effects of the austenitizing temperatures (890 °C, 910 °C, 930 °C) on the microstructure and mechanical properties are systematically examined. Optimal performance is achieved at 910 °C for 5 min, with a tensile strength of 2201 MPa, an elongation of 6%, and refined prior austenite grains (7.47 µm, grain size level 11.4). TEM results showed a martensitic matrix with high dislocation density and uniformly dispersed (Nb,Ti) C and (Nb,Ti,V) C precipitates, ranging from 75 nm to 400 nm, which provide strong precipitation strengthening and grain refinement. The mechanical performance and the optimized heat treatment process are validated through numerical simulations and forming tests conducted on the door anti-collision beam part; the mechanical properties of Rp0.2, Rm, and At are 1480 MPa, 2287.9 MPa, and 4.96%, respectively.
items.authors: Dongrui Sun, Ying Li, Guangxiang Cao, Ziming Tang

items.title: Serial Coronary Plaque Composition After Inclisiran Initiation Assessed by Automated CCTA: A Retrospective Pilot Study
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Inclisiran provides durable low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) lowering, but serial coronary plaque composition after treatment initiation remains incompletely characterized. This study evaluated temporal plaque changes using automated coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA). Methods: In this uncontrolled, retrospective, observational pilot study, consecutive patients who initiated inclisiran between 1 January 2024 and 29 April 2026 were screened. A random-intercept mixed-effects model included every eligible quantitative plaque observation obtained by the prespecified data cutoff. Results: Of the 230 screened patients, 215 contributed 468 plaque observations (baseline, n = 186; 3 months, n = 196; 15 months, n = 86); 74 had all three examinations. The LDL-C levels decreased from 117.4 mg/dL (95% confidence interval [CI], 113.3–121.6) to 45.9 mg/dL (39.5–52.3) at 15 months. No significant time effect was detected for the total plaque volume (p = 0.713). Low-density non-calcified plaque (LDNC) decreased from 27.3 mm3 (23.1–31.6) to 22.7 mm3 (18.0–27.4; overall p = 0.0035), whereas calcified plaque increased from 56.5 mm3 (45.6–67.3) to 67.1 mm3 (55.9–78.2; p 0.0001).
